features:
- [ADB & MULTI-DEVICE] Co lap ket noi ADB theo transport_id, giu nguyen serial phan cung USB de tranh trung/nham thiet bi va tu dong khoi phuc thiet bi offline.
- [MAGISK & ZYGISK] Chuan hoa kiem tra Zygisk built-in cua Magisk (--sqlite value=1, /debug_ramdisk/magisk, pidof zygiskd) va tu dong kich hoat Zygisk khi thieu zygisksu.
- [RESTORE & PLAY INTEGRITY] Chong nghen/timeout su sau Soft Reboot Zygote khi chay nhieu may song song, ref-count co defer va bo sung retry kiem tra Play Integrity.
